caption: This ramen features a rich amber, glossy miso broth with bubbles and submerged noodles. A pink, spiral-shaped Naruto fish cake rests in a white ceramic bowl with blue and green swirls, set on a wooden table with warm brown grain.

segments_info.text: Wooden table surface shows warm brown tones, visible grain patterns, and subtle texture variations.
The miso broth is rich amber, glossy, and textured with visible bubbles and submerged noodles.
White ceramic bowl with blue and green swirling pattern, smooth surface, slightly raised rim with decorative border.
Naruto fish cake: pink, spiral-shaped, with textured surface and visible white strands.
